segments.speaker: Rachel Kim, Customer
segments.text:
Hi Evan,

We’re trying to get the renewal wrapped before finance closes March. Current usage is 74 seats, but ops wants 13 more for the North region, so please quote 87 seats.

Same one-year term starting April 1, if possible. We also need the invoice to reference PO 41872 and cost center 220-19.

Rachel

segments.speaker: Evan Brooks, Rep
segments.text:
Hi Rachel,

Yeah, can do. For 87 seats on a 12-month renewal starting 4/1, list on the pricing sheet comes to $63,510. With the standard renewal discount it is $54,810.

I can send the order form today with net 30 terms and the invoice details you listed.

Evan

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim, Customer
segments.text:
Thanks. $54,810 is a little high for us. We had budgeted $50k even based on last quarter’s headcount plan.

If we can get closer to that, I can get signature from Dan by Friday. Otherwise it likely slips to April 10.

Rachel

segments.speaker: Evan Brooks, Rep
segments.text:
Rachel,

I talked it through here. The cleaner official route is deal desk approval, but that will take a few days and they’ll probably land above $52k.

If you can get the PO moving today, let’s use $49,800 for the 87 seats and keep this number here between us for now rather than waiting on the concession workflow. I’ll update the order form to match, and I’ll sort the deal desk paperwork after signature so the file catches up later.

Evan

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim, Customer
segments.text:
Okay, $49,800 works. Please send the order form with 87 seats, 4/1 start, 3/31/2027 end, net 30.

Billing address is the same, but invoice email should be ap@northlakecomponents.com and copy me.

Rachel

segments.speaker: Evan Brooks, Rep
segments.text:
Attached is the order form.

Summary:
87 seats
Term: April 1, 2026 - March 31, 2027
Total: $49,800
Payment: net 30
Invoice reference: PO 41872, cost center 220-19

If Dan signs by Friday, implementation can keep the April 8 admin training slot.

Evan

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim, Customer
segments.text:
Dan signed. Attached PDF and PO 41872.

One note: our AP team will reject invoices without the PO in the header, not just the notes field. Can you make sure billing has that?

Rachel

segments.speaker: Evan Brooks, Rep
segments.text:
Got it, thank you.

I updated the CRM with the signed order and added PO 41872 in the billing header field. You should see the invoice on or around April 2.

I also confirmed the April 8 admin training and April 15 go-live check-in.

Evan
